title: acre typesets math written in a subset of LaTeX
body:
A formula in a figure is typed as Unicode characters in the mono or sans font, such as `= ⌈log₂ 5⌉` in `key-schemes.acre`. Nothing sets fractions, roots or limits, and nothing spaces operators the way math is spaced.

Jack ruled out running LaTeX or any TeX engine, even to render. acre reads a subset of LaTeX math syntax and lays it out itself.

## Proposal

- Inline math as `$...$` inside any label's markup, and a `math` node for a display formula.
- A parser for the subset: `^` and `_`, `\frac`, `\sqrt`, Greek letters, common symbols (`\cdot`, `\le`, `\ge`, `\ne`, `\times`, `\lfloor`, `\rfloor`, `\lceil`, `\rceil`, arrows), `\log` and other operator names, `\text`, `\mathrm`, `\left ... \right` delimiters that grow, and `\sum` and `\prod` with limits.
- A layout after TeX's math rules from *The TeXbook*, appendix G: nested boxes, the four styles (display, text, script, scriptscript), atom classes with the spacing between each pair of classes, and the rules for scripts, fractions and radicals.
- The constants come from the font's OpenType MATH table, read with `ttf-parser`, as do the size variants and the pieces that build large delimiters and radicals.
- The math font is embedded like the text fonts. Start with Noto Sans Math, which is OFL, matches the Noto Sans text, and is installed on the development machine. Jack left the default open and asked that acre later take any math font the user gives it (acre-7101c7).

## Out of scope

Matrices, `align`, macros, and `\newcommand`. They can come after the subset works.

## Open

- Whether `$` needs an escape in labels that are not math, since `$` appears in DNA figures.

notes.text: Checked on 2026-11-13: /usr/share/fonts/noto/NotoSansMath-Regular.ttf carries a MATH table, as its table directory lists MATH beside GSUB and GPOS. The text measure this issue waits on landed in eff4b50 (crates/acre/src/text.rs). Jack asked for a design proposal before work starts, as with the shaping issue.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/ed2a7ee0
notes.text:
Landed in four commits on dev. 7f31032 embeds Noto Sans Math and reads its MATH table (`math/font.rs`). f78165c parses the subset (`math/parse.rs`). 60b20c0 sets it (`math/layout.rs`, with changes to `text.rs` and `render.rs`). 070e175 adds `$...$`, the `math` node and its schema entry. The syntax choices are a note on acre-4518a5.

Design:

- `math` is a module at the crate root beside `text`, because `text::layout` sets a formula inside a line and `render` draws it. It touches no file or screen, and it carries its own unit tests, as `text` does.
- A formula travels as a `Run` in `Font::Math` whose text is the LaTeX source. `text::layout` calls `math::layout` and appends the result to the line. Every glyph of the formula advances to its right edge, and an empty rule marks its left edge, so wrapping and measuring treat it as one piece that never breaks. `text::Glyph` now holds a `Mark`: an outline at its own size, or a filled rule for fraction and radical bars.
- Scripts follow TeX's rule 18 with the MATH constants. The baseline drops apply to every base, as the OpenType MATH constants define them, where TeX uses zero for a single character. `\left` and `\right` grow to TeX's target: 90.1% of the body, at most half an em short.
- `math::layout` takes `&MathFont`. `text::layout` passes `MathFont::noto()`, and `text::face(Font::Math)` returns the same font to the renderer. acre-7101c7 has to carry a chosen font to both places, because a `Mark` names a `Font` and not a font value.

I rendered fractions, roots with and without an index, scripts on scripts, `\sum` and `\prod` with limits, `\lim`, `\int`, grown parentheses, brackets, braces, floors and ceilings, inline and display, and the derived-values table of `key-schemes.acre` with its formulas moved into `$...$`. By eye the placement matches LaTeX's.

Open:

- Script glyphs are base glyphs scaled down. The font's `ssty` variants, drawn heavier for small sizes, are not used.
- A line with a tall inline formula keeps the fixed line height, so an inline `\displaystyle` sum overlaps the line above it. Only the first line's ascent and the last line's descent grow.
- `'` gives U+2032, which Noto Sans Math draws raised, so `f'` looks right. `x^{\prime}` sets that raised glyph again at script size and comes out too small and too high.
- Not yet read: `\binom`, accents such as `\hat` and `\vec`, `\overline`, `\mathbf` and the `\big` sizes.
